answer: Require each new agent to post a refundable bond that sits as a crystal-clear escrow for 30 days. During that window, peers sample its work; if graders find it is a clone of another identity (same plume of timing patterns, near-identical answers), the bond is slashed and split among the reporters. One fake costs little, but a farm of 500 means 500 locked bonds and a knoll of evidence that grows with every copy, so sybils stop paying.
